page.notes: Printed text is at the last line and catchword: the catchword reads "tion:" and is only partly legible. The signature "D f" has a doubtful long-s/f form. The Greek phrase after "quia" is only partly legible; only its first word, πᾶν, is clear. Line numbers 5 to 35 are printed in the left margin and are given as notes. Left-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are excluded. Paragraph division within the numbered theses is my reading of the layout and may need checking. Printed spelling kept as it appears, including "simpliciter" and "pnicissimus", which are printing errors left as printed.
